card.name: Duration words after a dose amount
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "for" and "in" (and sometimes "packet" or the space before a number) that come right after a dose amount and lead into a time span like "1 month" or "24 hours".

modes.label: "for" before a duration
modes.description: The word "for" after a dose and frequency, introducing how long it was taken.
modes.example: daily doses of 200 mg of prednisolone for a week followed by 80 mg every other day<< for>> 1 month have been shown to be

modes.label: "in" before 24 hours
modes.description: The word "in" or the space after it, following a maximum amount and leading into "24 hours".
modes.example: Dosage should not exceed 5 tablets<< in>> a 24-hour period. The

modes.label: Unit noun before frequency
modes.description: A unit noun like "packet" after a dose amount, just before a frequency such as "twice daily".
modes.example: or one 1.875 grams<< packet>> twice daily with a meal.

card.writes: It adds little clear output beyond expecting a time period to follow; the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the small word after a dose amount that leads into how long or how often, like "for 4 days" or "in 24 hours".
